project.title: Hagia Sophia — Spatial Memory
project.subtitle: 1494 years of historical events (532–2026 CE)
project.course: MBL549E — Special Topics in Architectural Design Computing

research_question: How have historical events shaped the spatial memory and emotional identity of Hagia Sophia across 1494 years (532–2026 CE)?

dataset.source: Manually curated from academic and historical sources

data_quality.duplicate_detail: Same earthquake names across different years (verified distinct events)
corrections_applied: EVT306: donem Bizans→Osmanli (1869 UNESCO, corrected period)
EVT160: mekan_sinif Cevre→Tum Yapi (minarets are part of whole building)

visualization.model: AyasofyaLayered2.obj (4 layers: Tum_Yapi, Dome, Ic_Mekan, Cevre)

axes.X: Spatial — East-West position in building plan
axes.Y: Spatial — North-South position in building plan
axes.Z: Temporal — Chronological (532 CE bottom → 2026 CE top)

encoding.shape: Impact factor (Human, Nature, Structural, Religious, Cultural, Health, Other)

interactions: Filter by Period, Spatial Type, Emotion, Impact Factor, Century
